claim: The reminder lane reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium demo context at /demo; visit once, wait for service-worker control, disconnect, reload, and assert the sample lane remains usable

claim: Imports keep reminders independently addressable even when backup IDs are duplicate or Java-hash-colliding.
sandbox: fresh demo IndexedDB at /demo; import duplicate IDs plus Aa/BB, assert deterministic unique row IDs, then edit only one duplicate

claim: The free tier arms at most three reminders while preserving extra imported reminders as paused.
sandbox: fresh unlicensed demo browser at /demo; import four enabled reminders and assert four rows, three active, and one visibly paused

claim: Ordinary reminder data stays on the device without analytics or tracking requests.
sandbox: fresh demo browser at /demo; record all requests while creating, persisting, and reloading a sample reminder; assert same-origin only

claim: Reminders repeat until you snooze or acknowledge them.
sandbox: fresh demo browser at /demo; assert the due sample repeats, snooze it, reset the demo, then acknowledge it and assert it is no longer due

claim: The sample demo keeps its reminder data separate from the real lane and discards changes on every exit.
sandbox: fresh browser opens /demo; seed a real-lane record, verify isolation, then change the sample and leave through Start for real, brand, legal, external, and checkout links; every return starts with fresh samples

claim: Exports download versioned JSON, and imports replace device data only after confirmation.
sandbox: fresh demo browser at /demo; download and parse all three sample reminders, then confirm a replacement import and assert only its reminder remains

claim: The handled-in-time score uses only acknowledgement history from the latest 30 days.
sandbox: fresh demo browser; import acknowledgements from 29 and 31 days ago, then assert the score counts only the recent record before and after reload; the exact millisecond boundary has a unit regression

claim: Reminders support one-time, daily, weekday, and weekly schedules, and an acknowledgement can be undone.
sandbox: fresh demo browser at /demo; observe one-time, daily, and weekly samples, change weekly to weekdays, acknowledge the due reminder, then Undo and assert it is due again

claim: Quiet hours mute notification repeats without hiding a due alert.
sandbox: fresh demo browser with a fixed clock; import a due reminder inside quiet hours and assert it stays visible while the lane marks its notifications muted

claim: The Android app re-arms a due reminder repeat from persisted native state without a running web timer.
sandbox: standard clean verifier; sync freshly built web assets, then validate the published APK digest, released native-source fingerprints, and compiled alarm receiver/repeat symbols without a local JDK/SDK; the same Robolectric behavior regression runs in GitHub Actions

claim: Android re-arms saved alarms after boot, clock changes, and time-zone changes.
sandbox: standard clean verifier; sync freshly built web assets, then validate the published APK digest, released native-source fingerprints, compiled rescheduler symbols, and registered boot/clock/time-zone actions without a local JDK/SDK; the same Robolectric behavior regression runs in GitHub Actions

claim: The published Android APK downloads and matches the displayed SHA-256 digest.
sandbox: local production server demo route; download the linked APK, assert it is over 1 MB, and compare its bytes with the displayed digest

claim: The downloadable Android APK contains this release's demo and reminder logic.
sandbox: standard clean verifier; sync a fresh native bundle, compare every embedded asset with the already-published APK, verify its displayed digest and released native-source fingerprints, and require the demo entry point/current service-worker shell; a fresh native release build runs in GitHub Actions

claim: Android users on v1.0.3 can install the published APK as an update.
sandbox: clean checkout; compare the v1.0.3 and published APK certificate subjects and SHA-256 fingerprints, then assert the shared application ID and a higher recorded version code

claim: US$4.99 is a one-time purchase for unlimited active reminders through Sociobot checkout.
where: landing page, Settings pricing, Terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser enters through /demo, starts a real lane, captures a returned fixture license, receives a recorded valid verification response, strips the token URL, imports four active reminders, and keeps all four active after reload
